health.content: Clinical dental trials showed the re-hardened enamel layer proved more resistant to acidic beverage erosion than original natural tooth surfaces...

health.title: Global Tobacco Reduction Measures Prevent Estimated 12 Million Premature Deaths
health.description: Comprehensive plain-packaging laws and smoking cessation clinic subsidies across sixty nations achieved record declines in smoking prevalence.
health.content: Health ministries reported steep decreases in youth nicotine uptake and sharp reductions in cardiovascular emergency hospital admissions...
